items.prompt: A valid public spot is 0.50, but an earlier helper requires spot>=1. What should this lesson's adapter do?

options.text: Reject the public case solely to preserve the old helper call.
options.why: That would fail the broader captured public domain.

options.text: Use the separate full-public-domain greeks function.
options.why: The tighter original helper remains unchanged rather than silently weakening its contract.

options.text: Round spot up to 1 before pricing.
options.why: That changes the supplied instrument/model input.

options.text: Interpret 0.50 as 50 shares instead of a spot price.
options.why: Input units cannot be rewritten to bypass a validation mismatch.

items.explanation: The tighter original helper remains unchanged rather than silently weakening its contract.
